<b>Cogwork Cleansers</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are stubby [[Cogwork Bugs|automatons]] forged to maintain the [[Cogwork Core]] and purge infestations.<ref>Cogwork Cleanser [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Steam shooting automaton, forged to clean the Cogwork Core and keep it free of infestation."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Cogwork Cleansers walk back and forth unpredictably whilst idle, pausing frequently. They make no attempt to pursue [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]], but if she approaches, they build up steam for a moment before ejecting it diagonally upwards in both directions at a low angle. The steam combos Hornet for {{Damage|1+1}} if she is caught in it at any time.

Due to the angle of the steam attack, neither jumping nor stepping back is effective. The most reliable options are to fully dash away or jump directly above the Cogwork Cleansers. [[Needle#Needle-bouncing|Needle-bouncing]] on top of them repeatedly can easily kill them.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Cogwork Cleansers have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

* ...To mend...

== Location ==
Cogwork Cleansers can be found in the [[Cogwork Core]], and one of them is fought as part of the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Cogwork Core 1|enemy gauntlet]] in the southwest of the area. After the fight, up to two of them can spawn upon each return to the arena.

==Trivia==
* Cogwork Cleansers share their Needolin dialogue with [[Cogwork Choirbug]]s, [[Cogwork Defender]]s, [[Cogwork Clapper]]s, [[Cogworker]]s, [[Cogwork Spine]]s, [[Cogwork Crawler]]s, and [[Cogwork Underfly|Cogwork Underflies]].
** Additionally, they share their singing audio with Cogwork Choirbugs.
